purpose: Explicit minimal source allowlist for bounded Cloud Windows build/test rounds. Producing commit and per-file hashes are frozen at input assembly; the generated manifest travels with the source archive.

includeNotes.src/**: complete app source including src/renderer/index.html + styles.css
includeNotes.scripts/closeBound.mjs: awaitExit/boundedClose used by smoke flow for owned-process exit confirmation
includeNotes.package-lock.json: REQUIRED — npm ci reproduces the exact dependency set
includeNotes.frozen-source-manifest: generated next to this list at freeze time; carried as an additional file outside the allowlist
includeNotes.helpers/win32/**: job-helper is now a REAL packaging input — compiled per build by build-job-helper.ps1 into dist/job-helper/, shipped outside the ASAR
includeNotes.tests/windows/*.cpp: compiled by the SAME build script (job-fixture.exe + codex-launcher.exe + terminal-fixture.exe) — build fails without them; they are never packaged
includeNotes.tests/windows/harness-control.mjs: imported by packaged-job-test.mjs and terminal-harness.mjs for three-state process identity queries
includeNotes.scripts/windows/packaged-job-test.mjs: offline application-layer packaged-job validation entry point
includeNotes.scripts/windows/packaged-git-test.mjs: offline application-layer packaged read-only Git acceptance entry point (real git.exe, never packaged)
includeNotes.scripts/windows/packaged-terminal-test.m: offline application-layer packaged terminal acceptance — requires a --terminal-candidate package, refuses ordinary bundles
includeNotes.tests/windows/helper-harness.mjs+owner-r: native --serve/--run helper contract suite; harness updated for the 1.2.0 --run exit-code channel
includeNotes.tests/windows/terminal-harness.mjs+termi: native --terminal ConPTY contract suite (NDJSON protocol, credit flow control, Job/console/containment proofs) for the 1.3.0 helper
includeNotes.tests/windows/terminal-session.mjs: shared session-side logic imported by terminal-harness.mjs (stdout ingest, sessionReady, diagnostics) — the harness fails to load without it
includeNotes.cli/tivano.mjs: local-control CLI client shipped as an extraResource — packaged CLI acceptance needs the real file in the bundle

excludeNotes.helpers/win32/BUILD.md: documentation only — the helper sources themselves are included above
excludeNotes.tests/**: Only explicitly included tests/windows native fixtures, harness and control files are exceptions; explicit paths beat this glob.
excludeNotes.docs/**: phase documentation/evidence, never a build input
excludeNotes.scripts/e2e.mjs+dev.mjs+dev-smoke-harnes: POSIX dev-loop only, not part of the Windows packaging path
